evidence: log loss +0.0153 (95% interval +0.0060 to +0.0237). The model's probabilities are WORSE than the market's closing probabilities (the interval is above zero).

287 picks, ROI +1.7% (95% interval -7.0% to +10.2%), win rate 60.6% against a break-even 58.9%. Random sides at the same margin match or beat this 10% of the time. Line movement toward the pick after it was made: +0.13 probability points on average (zero means no closing-line value).
How many bets before ROI can be trusted

At the observed spread of results, detecting a true 3% ROI takes about 4,837 bets and a 5% ROI about 1,742; a 1% edge takes 43,528. Closing-line value converges much faster, which is why it is the primary measure.
